mission_03: EXISTS is the right tool for presence checks. It returns TRUE if the subquery returns any rows, FALSE otherwise — no duplicates, no aggregation needed.
Inside the EXISTS subquery, write `SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id`. The correlation links each order row to the current customer row being evaluated.
The key difference from JOIN: EXISTS stops scanning as soon as it finds one matching order. It doesn't expand into multiple rows per customer.
